scientific_limitations: Only ordered binary alphabets and positive values of both symbol counts are covered by the sharp-factor claim.
The asymptotic limit is taken at fixed positive zero count with the one count tending to infinity.
No impossibility of exact-density CAT enumeration is claimed; a different method is known.
Historical priority outside inspected and indexed sources has not received independent expert review.
title: Sharp exact-content overhead for binary quasinecklaces
